source_campaign: T010 Народни танци - тестова кампания (PAIN, HERO, PROMISE)

banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The image must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames, no inner frame, no blurred strips).
LAYOUT (critical - the final banner is cut to 4:5 from the centre of this tall frame, so the top 15% and the bottom 15% are thrown away): the top 19% of the frame contains ONLY plain background. The headline starts at about 21% from the top. The bottom of the CTA button is at about 77% from the top. Everything below 80% is ONLY plain background. Keep about 7% side margins.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, from the top): 0-20% only background. 21-29% the headline (two lines, VERY BIG). 30-36% the subheadline (TWO lines). 37-69% the scene with the book. 71-77% the CTA button. 79-100% only background.
FORMAT: PAIN - a real photo of the problem moment (IMAGE 3 is a winning PAIN banner of ours - use it only for typography and layout, not its scene).
STOP-THE-SCROLL (critical, must read in one second even as a small thumbnail): NO FACE. Over-the-shoulder view from behind a Bulgarian person around 50 (only the back of the shoulder, the back of the head slightly out of focus at the edge, and one hand holding a glass of wine on the table) sitting ALONE at a festive table with a white tablecloth, plates and bread, in a Bulgarian restaurant / mehana celebration. In front, softly blurred but clearly recognisable: a long happy horo line of people holding hands and dancing, warm festive lights, colourful clothes. The empty chairs next to the person show everyone else is dancing. Strong contrast between the still, lonely person in the foreground and the joyful moving horo.
BOOK: the book (IMAGE 2) stands UPRIGHT on the table next to the plate, front cover facing the camera, about 22% of the banner width, clearly readable, not floating.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline across the full width at the top on a soft dark gradient, white, heavy, VERY BIG, two lines: "Пак ли стоиш на масата, докато всички играят хоро?" - make "докато всички играят хоро?" yellow #F5C518.
2) Subheadline under it, white, bold, medium size (about 4.5% of the banner height - clearly smaller than the headline), split on TWO lines: line 1 "Научи 7-те основни стъпки и се хващай" / line 2 "на всяко хоро, без да объркаш." (exactly these words).
3) CTA button: "Искам да играя 👉"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "Български народни танци от нулата" (it shows the cover design - use only the book itself). Reproduce it exactly on the physical book: white cover with red-and-green Bulgarian embroidery borders at top and bottom, red title "БЪЛГАРСКИ НАРОДНИ ТАНЦИ", golden "ОТ НУЛАТА", a small subtitle paragraph, a photo of a joyful horo line of men and women in folk-style clothes on a village square, the first man holding a Bulgarian flag, author "СТОЯН ГЕОРГИЕВ" and the golden key "Златен Ключ" logo - same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation, quotation marks and capital letters. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic).
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline about 4.5-5% of the banner height (bold, clearly smaller than the headline), CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white text on dark areas or near-black text on light areas; accent words in yellow #F5C518; no grey text.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white text, centred near the bottom of the central area. The pointing-hand emoji at the end of the CTA is drawn as a small yellow pointing-right hand icon.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, percentages or website addresses anywhere. No phone screens, no chat or messenger interface, no notification badges.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each. No flags other than the Bulgarian tricolour, no political symbols.
BOOK REALISM (critical - the book must NOT look pasted in like a sticker): a real, physically present paperback in the scene, lit by the SAME light, soft natural shadow, realistic size (a normal 13x20 cm paperback). The cover design and title must still be recognisable and must stand out from what is behind it.
CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 78% of the frame height, with clear empty space below it (at least 3% of the frame).
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, labels on clothes, brand names or written papers besides the book cover.
